title: One line of the ledger of record (CDIR/ledger/segment-NNNNNN.jsonl)
description: AS BUILT: rustred_campaign::ledger::Record (interfaces/ledger-and-progress.md 2-3). Closed list of kinds; the ledger is never read tolerantly (unknown kinds and fields refused; the reader also requires the canonical bytes). Line = the canonical serialisation of the record WITHOUT `h`, with `,"h":"<BLAKE3 of those bytes>"` inserted before the final brace; `prev` = `h` of the previous record (64 zeros for seq 1). `job_progress` is no longer a ledger kind (samples go to progress/jobs.json).

anyOf.description: comparison only (U-9): never read by any check
